content.trans: 我将在一分钟后完成。

content.text: Let me just finish this level of this game.
content.trans: 我只完成这个等级的游戏。

content.text: No, I said now.
content.trans: 英语：不，我说了。

content.text: Plus you are grounded.
content.trans: 您是被束缚的。

content.text: You're not allowed to play video games.
content.trans: 你不能玩视频游戏。

content.text: I want you to make your bed, do the laundry, and then come downstairs and sweep the floors.
content.trans: 我想要你把床铺做好，然后洗衣服，最后再帮我扫地。

content.text: That's so unfair.
content.trans: 太不公平了。

content.text: You have to pull your weight around here, young man.
content.trans: 你得在这些地方承担你的分量，年轻人。

content.text: My house, my rules.
content.trans: 我的房子，我的规则。

content.text: But I already mop the floors, dusted the furniture, and vacuum the rugs.
content.trans: 但是我已经打扫过地板、家具和地毯了。

content.text: That's great, but you still have work to do, so get to it.
content.trans: 好的，我明白了。请将需要翻译的英文语句提供给我吧。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Very good.
content.trans: 非常棒。

content.text: So doing household chores is not a fun thing, but also being grounded.
content.trans: 所以做家务并不有趣，但同时也是踏实的。

content.text: Why do we consider chores to be kind of like a punishment?
content.trans: 为什么我们把家务看作是一种惩罚？

content.text: Well, there's punishment where you sit alone in your room and you think about your actions,
content.trans: 嗯，你一个人坐在房间里，思考你的行为，

content.text: and then there's punishment that's more pro-active.
content.trans: 英语：然后就该有更积极的惩罚了。

content.text: Mom and dad say, okay, well, he's grounded.
content.trans: 妈妈和爸爸说，好的，好吧，他被扣了。

content.text: Let's have him work.
content.trans: 让我们让他工作。

content.text: Let's make him do something.
content.trans: 让我们让他做点什么。

content.text: Let's make him do something so that we're benefiting from his punishment.
content.trans: 让我们让他做点什么，这样我们才能从他的惩罚中受益。

content.text: I think it's also good when children are grounded because it makes them realize that they need
content.trans: 我倒是觉得，当孩子们被引导时，这也有好处，因为让他们明白自己需要什么。

content.text: to help out around the house.
content.trans: 英语：帮助在家里做家务。

content.text: That it's this work.
content.trans: 这句话的中文翻译是：“这是这个工作。”

content.text: It doesn't get done magically.
content.trans: 英语：它不会自动完成。

content.text: There's actually someone doing it.
content.trans: 英语：实际上有人在做这件事。

content.text: It's not like, well, in many cases in many countries, people will have, like we saw in our
content.trans: 在许多国家，人们可能会有类似我们看到的情况。

content.text: previous lesson, a domestic maid, a cleaning lady that will usually do everything.
content.trans: 上一个课程，一个家庭主妇，她通常会做所有的事情。

content.text: So maybe the kid will become very comfortable and not really do anything.
content.trans: 所以，也许这个孩子会变得非常舒适，并且不会真的做任何事。

content.text: We're very lazy.
content.trans: 我们很懒。

content.text: Very lazy.
content.trans: 很懒。

content.text: Even worse, yeah.
content.trans: 更糟糕的是，对啊。

content.text: So I definitely remember in my house, we had chores because when it's not punishment,
content.trans: 所以，我绝对记得，在我家，我们总是有家务事的，因为不是惩罚。

content.text: when it's your parents' expectation normally, that's called a chore.
content.trans: 当它正常地属于你的父母的期望时，这被称为一个任务。

content.text: And they say, okay, Katherine, you're chores this week.
content.trans: 他们说，好的，凯特琳，本周你做家务。

content.text: You need to take the garbage outside.
content.trans: 你得把垃圾扔出去。

content.text: You need to wash the dishes and you need to make your bed every day.
content.trans: 你得把碗洗了，每天都要整理你的床。

content.text: And then maybe my brother had to help cook and clean the floor, mop the floors and sweep.
content.trans: 英语：然后，也许我的哥哥得帮我做点家务，比如洗碗、拖地和扫地。

content.text: So we have different chores.
content.trans: 所以我们有不同的任务。

content.text: And I guess this is more common, especially if both parents work and everyone is collaborating
content.trans: 而且我猜想这是更普遍的，尤其是在父母都工作且大家都协作的情况下。

content.text: or pulling their weight in the house.
content.trans: 或者在家中拖泥带水。

content.text: And if you don't have a cleaning lady, for example.
content.trans: 如果没有清洁工，例如。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: Very interesting topic.
content.trans: 非常有趣的话题。

content.text: Well, that's all the time we have for today.
content.trans: 好的，今天我们的时间有限。

content.text: If you guys have any questions, any comments, you can find us at EnglishPod.com.
content.trans: 如果你们有任何问题或评论，请随时联系我们：英语pod.com。

content.text: We hope to see you there.
content.trans: 我们希望你能在这里见到我们。

content.text: We'll see you guys.
content.trans: 我们见了。

content.text: Bye.
content.trans: 再见。
